subject: SIG questionnaire: evidence submission & acceptance plan
messages:
From: Lauren Myers <lauren.myers@orchardbank.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@orchardbank.com>, Andy Cole <andy.cole@consultco.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: SIG questionnaire: evidence submission & acceptance plan

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Orchard Bank is moving this into the final evaluation bucket and we need to start collecting SIG responses and evidence artifacts so our InfoSec & Procurement can complete the assessment by mid-September.

Attached is our baseline SIG spreadsheet (SIG_Questionnaire_OrchardBank.xlsx) — fill where applicable and point to evidence artifacts for any control marked "In scope". Our immediate asks:
- SOC 2 report (most recent) and scope statement
- ISO 27001 certificate + scope
- Sample access logs (redacted) showing privileged user activity
- KMS proof (key rotation policy or audit extract)

Can you confirm an evidence acceptance plan (format, delivery mechanism, and reviewer SLA)? We also need a short mapping of which Redwood controls map to our SIG IDs so our reviewers can cross-check quickly.

Appreciate a quick reply with next steps/fallbacks.

Thanks,
Lauren Myers
Senior Sourcing Manager
Orchard Bank

Attachments: SIG_Questionnaire_OrchardBank.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodai.com>
To: Lauren Myers <lauren.myers@orchardbank.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodai.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire: evidence submission & acceptance plan

Hi Lauren — thanks for the spreadsheet and timeline. We can commit to the mid-September window; below is a proposed acceptance plan and immediate next steps.

Acceptance plan (high level):
1) Evidence types accepted: PDF, CSV, XLSX, TXT (logs), and PDFs for certificates/reports.
2) Delivery mechanism: secure Drive folder (shared) + hashed filenames; sensitive logs uploaded to our SFTP link (we will provide one-time credentials).
3) Reviewer SLA: we will provide a mapped control file and initial artifacts within 5 business days, and dedicated reviewer turnaround for Orchard of 3 business days for each artifact package.
4) Escalation: For any missing strict proofs (e.g., raw KMS key material), we will provide KMS audit extracts and architecture diagrams with signed statements from our security team.

Immediate next steps:
- I will share a Redwood evidence pack (SOC 2 summary and evidence ingest playbook) and a SIG mapping template by end of day.
- Internal owners: Neha (SOC 2/ISO artifacts), Karthik (KMS + access logs), Jasmine (evidence upload coordination).

Attaching our SOC 2 summary for quick review and a short evidence-ingest-playbook with instructions. If the format works, we will populate your SIG_Questionnaire_OrchardBank.xlsx with mapping references (link/file name).

Sofia Ivanova
Manager, Assurance & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-soc2-report-2026.pdf (pdf), evidence-ingest-playbook.md (md)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodai.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodai.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodai.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: Orchard Bank SIG — owners and artifact checklist

Team — looping you in to coordinate Orchard Bank intake. Deadline: initial mapping + artifacts uploaded to Drive by Tue 24 Aug COB (we'll ask for staged delivery if anything needs redaction). Priorities and owners below:

- SOC 2 scope + report: Neha -> produce PDF + one-page scope summary.
- ISO 27001: Neha -> certificate + signed scope statement.
- Access logs (sample): Karthik -> supply 7-day redacted sample, include fields (timestamp, user, action, resource, IP). Use log-redact script and provide sha256 checksum.
- KMS evidence: Karthik -> rotation policy excerpt + KMS audit extract showing key rotation events for the past 12 months.
- Evidence ingest & upload: Jasmine -> create Drive folder, set viewer restrictions, post HubSpot ticket link in folder readme.

Please confirm by EOD and paste upload links in the HubSpot ticket. If any owner expects a delay, call it out now so I can manage expectations with Orchard.

Thanks — Sofia

Quoted for context:
> From: Lauren Myers <lauren.myers@orchardbank.com>
> Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 09:22:00 -0700
> Subject: SIG questionnaire: evidence submission & acceptance plan
>
> Thanks again for the demo last week. Orchard Bank is moving this into the final evaluation bucket...

From: Lauren Myers <lauren.myers@orchardbank.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@orchardbank.com>, Andy Cole <andy.cole@consultco.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire: evidence submission & acceptance plan

Sofia — quick follow-up/questions from our InfoSec reviewer:
1) Access logs: Can the sample include both console (UI) and API event types? We need an example showing privilege elevation and the corresponding admin approval entries (redacted identifiers are OK).
2) KMS: the reviewer asked for evidence of automated rotation and the audit extract. If rotation is only policy-based and not enforced by schedule, please flag that as a control gap upfront.
3) Mapping: can you include the specific Redwood system component / artifact name next to each SIG control so the reviewer can fetch the artifact quickly?

Also attaching a short note from our procurement lead on acceptance criteria (Procurement wants explicit naming, filenames, and signed statements for any architecture diagrams).

On Thu, 19 Aug 2027 at 09:12 AM, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodai.com> wrote:
> Hi Lauren — thanks for the spreadsheet and timeline. We can commit to the mid-September window; below is a proposed acceptance plan and immediate next steps.

Thanks,
Lauren

Attachments referenced: none (their procurement note will be uploaded to the Drive).

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodai.com>
To: Lauren Myers <lauren.myers@orchardbank.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodai.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodai.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire: evidence submission & acceptance plan

Hi Lauren — thanks for the clarifying questions. We completed the initial evidence bundle and uploaded to the secured Drive folder linked here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-Orchard-SIG (access: OrchardBank@orchardbank.com). Summary below and acceptance checklist for your InfoSec/procurement team.

Delivered artifacts (Drive folder / SFTP):
- redwood-soc2-report-2026.pdf (SOC 2 report, auditor attestation)
- ISO27001_certificate_2019_scope.pdf (ISO certificate + scope statement)
- access-logs-sample.pdf (7-day redacted sample; includes UI and API event types with admin approvals redacted IDs; sha256: 3a7f...)
- SIG_Mapping_v1.xlsx (mapping: SIG control -> Redwood system component -> artifact file name)
- KMS_rotation_audit_excerpt.csv (rotation events extract)

Acceptance checklist (proposed):
- Filenames and mapped control references present: YES (see SIG_Mapping_v1.xlsx)
- Evidence format acceptable (PDF/XLSX/CSV): YES
- Sensitive items uploaded to SFTP with checksums: YES
- Signed architecture diagram included where referenced: YES (arch-diagram-signed.pdf)
- Reviewer SLA acknowledged (3 business days per package): YES

Next steps:
- Please confirm receipt and if the attachments meet Orchard's acceptance criteria. If accepted, we can finalize the SIG mapping and provide a short recorded walkthrough for your reviewers (20 min).
- If you need any redactions or additional extracts, note the exact SIG control ID and we will prioritize.
- DocuSign amendment (if needed) for sharing restricted logs is at: https://www.docusign.net/secure/DocuSign/AUTHLINK123456

If everything looks good I will mark the HubSpot ticket OB-9876 as awaiting reviewer signoff.

Best regards,
Sofia Ivanova
Manager, Assurance & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SIG_Mapping_v1.xlsx (xlsx), access-logs-sample.pdf (pdf), redwood-soc2-report-2026.pdf (pdf)
